roles.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
roles.location: Fully remote, global; client meetings in US morning = his afternoon/evening
roles.why: The closest single match found in either pass. Asks 2-5 years, which is his band, and the named toolset reads like his CV: Zapier, Make, n8n, MS Power Platform, OpenAI and Anthropic, REST APIs, plus CRM and Airtable-style systems. Fully remote worldwide with no country gate, and the stated working hours (US morning) land in his afternoon and evening from Venice.
roles.watch_outs: Client-facing consulting rhythm with quarterly global meetups. Comp is not disclosed, so establish the band early.

roles.title: Sr AI Engineer (TS / Vue / NodeJS)
roles.why: The single closest role in this sweep. n8n is the tool he has actually shipped automations with at UltraStrategy and Get2Germany, and the stack line is his CV verbatim: TypeScript, Node.js, LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic), React a bonus. Eligibility sentence explicitly says applicants outside Germany need existing work rights, which he has, so the permit is a selling point here rather than a hurdle.
roles.watch_outs: Asks 5+ years building web products; he has 3. Apply anyway and let the n8n fluency carry it.

roles.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
roles.location: Remote - EMEA (apply to the location you would work from)
roles.why: No minimum years stated, which is rare and removes the usual gate. Wants solid full-stack or backend engineering plus APIs, auth patterns, data models and event-driven systems - all things he did on FlowSpace integrations. Familiarity with n8n or similar workflow tools is listed as nice-to-have and he has it as a daily driver.
roles.watch_outs: Customer-facing role; he has no FDE title yet. Same right-to-work rule as above.

roles.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
roles.why: Asks 1-3 years of relevant engineering experience, which is extraordinary for an FDE title and is squarely his band rather than a stretch. The stack is his: TypeScript, NestJS, Postgres, Prisma, React, TanStack, Tailwind. The band starts above his stated expectation and tops out at nearly double it.
roles.watch_outs: On-site Berlin, and the posting says eligibility to work in Germany without sponsorship, with no sponsorship available. His EU long-term residence permit gives him Article 14 mobility, so he files for a German permit himself rather than being sponsored - say that explicitly in the application so it is not mistaken for a visa request.
roles.verified: fetched 8 Aug 2026 - live, apply link confirmed

roles.title: MarTech Engineer - AI & Automation
roles.why: Asks for 2-3 years, which is exactly his band - the best seniority match in the whole sweep. Stack is Make.com, Zapier, Node.js, Python, GTM/GA4/Segment plus LangChain and CrewAI as nice-to-haves. His FlowSpace GTM automation and CRM work is the same shape of job under a different title.
roles.watch_outs: MarTech framing means marketing-ops stakeholders, not a pure engineering team. He has no Customer.io or HubSpot admin history.

roles.title: Technical Programs Manager - Scaled Customer Success
roles.location: Remote - Europe (rights to work in Europe, or relocate to Germany)
roles.why: The fourth n8n opening he fits, and the eligibility line is written for him: 'rights to work in Europe' with sponsorship only needed for Germany. Asks 3-5+ years as an individual contributor in solutions engineering, technical account management or technical onboarding, which is his band. Named skills are APIs, webhooks, JSON, JavaScript and workflow automation, with n8n experience a bonus he already has.
roles.watch_outs: Programme-management framing means less hands-on building than the engineering reqs. Pick this or the FDE role as the primary n8n application, not both as identical letters.

roles.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer, EMEA
roles.why: 2-5 years hands-on software development - his band - with TypeScript one of the three languages where two are required. Highest disclosed comp in the sweep by a distance, and EMEA-remote rather than country-locked.

roles.title: Deployment Strategist - Europe

Named stack is Python, API integration, LLM frameworks and AI agent tooling - the agent side is his strongest current area. Remote globally, so no location gate at all.
